title: Lance Roberts: Will 2026 Be The Year Stocks Revert To The Mean?

excerpts.label: Mean reversion is the most powerful force
excerpts.insight: 15-year returns 50% above 125-year average; trading at 2+ std devs from mean—reversion is inevitable, timing unknown
excerpts.pm_takeaway: DON'T FIGHT MEAN REVERSION. You're 2 std devs above the mean. Crash is 100% coming—you just don't know when. Manage deviations, don't predict timing.

excerpts.label: Valuation range: 8,100 to 4,600
excerpts.insight: S&P 2026 range depends on multiple expansion vs contraction—75% spread between bull and bear cases
excerpts.pm_takeaway: PLAN FOR BOTH. 8,100 if multiples expand, 4,600 if recession. Don't bet the farm on one outcome. Have playbooks for each scenario.

excerpts.label: Wood soaked in gasoline—waiting for match
excerpts.insight: All conditions for crash exist (valuations, leverage, sentiment) but catalyst and timing unknowable
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STAY INVESTED but prepared. The setup is there. Don't sell preemptively on valuation—wait for technical breakdown. Have your playbook ready.

excerpts.label: Markets will crash 50%—guaranteed
excerpts.insight: 100% guarantee of 50%+ crash—but could be 10 years out. Market deteriorates before event, not after.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: WATCH FOR DETERIORATION not prediction. Crash doesn't happen overnight. Market goes down 5-10% first, THEN event hits. Cut when technicals break.

excerpts.label: Full-time employment falling—recession signal
excerpts.insight: Full-time employment as % of working age population declining—only happens in recessions
excerpts.pm_takeaway: THIS IS THE KEY DATA. Full-time jobs falling = consumer spending falls = earnings miss. Watch jobs data closer than anything else in 2026.

excerpts.label: Rebalancing: the unsexy stuff that works
excerpts.insight: Silver 5% → 7% on rally, trim to 5%. Crashes to 3%, buy back to 5%. Always work around target allocation.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: THIS IS HOW YOU SURVIVE. Buy low, sell high through mechanical rebalancing. Most people buy high, never sell, crash, sell at loss. Don't be most people.
